entry.author: ACC New Zealand
entry.summary:
Some movement, like a few holes of leisurely golf, can help you recover sooner from a sprain or strain.

It can help blood flow, reduce stiffness and support healing.

SUBSCRIBE for more ACC New Zealand stories ▶ https://www.youtube.com/c/accnz/

If you're injured in an accident in New Zealand, whether it's relatively minor or something more serious, we're here to give you care and support so you can get back to everyday life. 

We help with prevention, care and recovery: https://www.acc.co.nz/about-us/
